component.name: Face Unlock
component.summary: Sign in and unlock your computer with your face

description.p: Face Unlock brings Windows Hello–style face authentication to Ubuntu. It uses an RGB or infrared camera. An infrared illuminator can help in the dark. Face recognition is a convenience: it is less secure than a strong password.

ul.li: Unlock the login screen and lock screen by looking at the camera
Approve administrator prompts and sudo without typing your password
Your password always works as a fallback
Face data is stored only on this computer

description.p: Light and dark glass themes, saved appearance settings, and animated face guides.
